question: The diagram shows 4 blocks in contact on a smooth surface. A 32N force acts on block 1 from the left, and the surface can be considered frictionless. Calculate:
question_parts: The net force on each block
The contact forces for each block
answer_parts: The acceleration of the system is 1ms^-2
Each block has an acceleration of 1ms^-2

Block 1 has a net force of 1N
Block 2 has a net force of 20N
Block 3 has a net force of 3N
Block 4 has a net force of 8N

Block 1 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 32N Applied force, -31N Contact Reaction force
Block 2 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 31N Contact force, -11N Contact Reaction force
Block 3 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 11N Contact force, -8N Contact Reaction force
Block 4 has 1 force acting on it. They are: 8N Contact force
